title: Your First Game
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels that use a little of everything: walking and jumping, coins, a friendly gumdrop, spikes, and a key for a locked door. A small, whole game with a title, an ending and signs along the way, made to be copied and changed. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and make it yours.

box.back: A small explorer in a gold beanie crosses three short levels with a little of everything: a jump over a wall, coins, a friendly gumdrop, spikes to hop and a key for a locked door. It is a whole small game, from the title to the ending, made to be copied. Open it in Game-Maker and change anything you like.
features: Three levels that use what the other Starters teach
A guide to making it your own, step by step
Made to be copied and taken apart
